records.text: But I think the majority of the world was just looking at Ben-Gvir (Itamar Ben-Gvir) rooting for them, Bibi Netanyahu. In general, we hate psychopathic genocidal murderers and having them explicitly come out and say that they were rooting for that team to win was not helpful.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
